summary: Bulacan 2nd District representative. Authored a call for a constitutional convention, travel-tax abolition, GSIS membership for separated non-career employees and many regional trial court branch bills. One issue per dimension. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.

economic.label: Insufficient evidence
economic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
